title: Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit Member Terms — Earlier Losses
content:
**Term.** Under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, earlier losses reduce the replacement for lost, stolen or damaged medication:

- when a lost, stolen or damaged replacement was granted for the same drug in the last twelve months, 7 days are taken off the lost days;
- when one was granted only for another drug in the last twelve months, 3 days are taken off;
- otherwise nothing is taken off.

The earlier replacements looked at are the lost, stolen or damaged replacement overrides already granted on the member's retail benefit in the last twelve months.

## The term applied (hypothetical members)

| Earlier lost, stolen or damaged replacements in the last twelve months | Days taken off the lost days |
|---|---|
| One for the same drug | 7 |
| One for the same drug and one for another drug | 7 |
| Only for another drug | 3 |
| None, or only more than twelve months ago | 0 |
